description: Fetches defense and security news articles from StratPost (stratpost.com), including article content, latest headlines, and search functionality.

function.description:
要调用的功能名。可用值:
  - get_article: Extract a single article by URL; requires url parameter; 参数: url; 必填: url
  - get_latest: Get latest articles from homepage; optional limit parameter; 参数: limit; 必填: 无
  - search: Search articles by keyword; requires query parameter; 参数: query, limit; 必填: query

url.description: Full URL of the StratPost article to extract (used by get_article)

limit.description: Maximum number of articles to return (used by get_latest and search)

query.description: Search keyword or phrase (used by search)
